title: Learning Deterministic and Stochastic Forced Hamiltonian Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.19688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop a geometric framework for learning deterministic and stochastic forced Hamiltonian systems with neural networks. Motivated by the Lagrange-d'Alembert principle and the theory of variational integrators, we introduce the notion of a Lagrange-d'Alembert map and establish a $C^r$ convergence theorem for first-order one-step methods. Building on these results, we propose Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (GFHNNs), a class of structure-preserving neural networks obtained by concatenating Lagrange-d'Alembert-Euler maps, and prove a universal approximation theorem for this architecture. We further extend the framework to parameter-dependent systems, leading to Parametric Generalized Forced Hamiltonian Neural Networks (PGFHNNs). translated_title: 学习确定性和随机受迫哈密顿系统
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个几何框架，用于通过神经网络学习确定性和随机受迫哈密顿系统。受拉格朗日-达朗贝尔原理和变分积分器理论的启发，我们引入了拉格朗日-达朗贝尔映射的概念，并为一阶单步方法建立了C^r收敛定理。基于这些结果，我们提出了广义受迫哈密顿神经网络（GFHNNs），这是一类通过串联拉格朗日-达朗贝尔-欧拉映射获得的结构保持神经网络，并证明了该架构的通用逼近定理。我们进一步将框架扩展到参数依赖系统，从而引出参数化广义受迫哈密顿神经网络（PGFHNNs）。通过将Stratonovich-泰勒展开中出现的多个Stratonovich积分解释为参数，同一框架也可应用于随机受迫哈密顿系统。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于几何框架的结构保持神经网络（GFHNNs和PGFHNNs），用于学习确定性和随机受迫哈密顿系统，并证明了其收敛性和通用逼近性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a geometric framework-based structure-preserving neural network (GFHNNs and PGFHNNs) for learning deterministic and stochastic forced Hamiltonian systems, with proven convergence and universal approximation properties.
